description: Complete registry of 200 specialized subagents for the Subagent Swarm in oh-my-claudecode.

subagents.name: performance-profiler

subagents.name: handoff-negotiator

subagents.name: blackboard-manager

subagents.name: status-reporter

subagents.name: web-researcher

subagents.name: codebase-miner

subagents.name: pattern-recognizer

subagents.name: api-doc-miner

subagents.name: design-pattern-hunter

discovery_logic: Registry-driven matching via agent-matcher subagent. SCP messages carry from/to for routing. Blackboard used for shared state. Generator script creates new entries from template.
notes: This is the expanded registry. Implemented subagents have full definitions in subagents/. Use the generator script to add the remaining ones quickly. Total target: 200.
